data: In fiscal 2025 (the year ended September 27, 2025), Apple reported net sales of $416,161 million (about $416.2 billion) and gross margin of $195,201 million (about $195.2 billion), which gives a gross margin of roughly 46.9%. Operating income was $133,050 million (about $133.1 billion), for an operating margin of roughly 32.0%. Both are up from fiscal 2024, when gross margin was about 46.2% on revenue of $391,035 million and operating margin was about 31.5%. All figures come from Apple's fiscal 2025 Form 10-K (accession 0000320193-25-000079).
